**Counts:** derived 6 findings / submitted 0 / failed 0.

**Critical findings**

- [GateRow.tsx:90](/w/src/components/session/GateRow.tsx:90): clearing a successfully answered gate changes `gateKey`, and the reset effect clears `chosen`. The required “You chose: …, HH:MM” receipt therefore disappears after the POST.
- [GateRow.tsx:233](/w/src/components/session/GateRow.tsx:233): the choices have no `title`, visible “suggested” marker, or radio semantics. The required recommendation and hover explanations are absent.
- [GateRow.tsx:272](/w/src/components/session/GateRow.tsx:272): the closed disclosure contains only the raw prompt. It omits verdict layers, failing items, floor checks, and the reviewer’s note.
- [gateRowModel.ts:167](/w/src/board/gateRowModel.ts:167): escalation recommendations are inferred from a nonempty note instead of `recommendGateMove`. Reassignment also uses previously assigned unit seats rather than the run’s `session.clis` pool, with no roster eligibility check; valid helpers can be missing and ineligible ones can be offered.
- [gateRowModel.ts:63](/w/src/board/gateRowModel.ts:63): every engine choice other than `approve` and `request_changes` maps to the same rejection. Distinct team or custom choices consequently send indistinguishable answers.
- [ProposalCard.tsx:123](/w/src/components/session/ProposalCard.tsx:123): delivery details contain no diffstat or repository name, so they do not identify the requested push target and changes.

**Open questions:** The run record’s deterministic floor exit codes were not provided here. The in-process journey also does not exercise reassign, stop, 409 recovery, or delivery details; those checks remain unverified by the evidence available in this phase.
